identity.title: Rotational Spectrum and First Interstellar Detection of 2-methoxyethanol Using ALMA Observations of NGC 6334I

question.value: Can the laboratory rotational spectrum of 2-methoxyethanol be extended to mm/sub-mm frequencies and used to search for the molecule toward NGC 6334I and IRAS 16293-2422B, and what do the abundance differences imply for formation chemistry?

referee_caveats_inferred: Detection rests on 25 transitions of which only nine are unblended or partially blended; blending treatment is not described
Column density depends on a source-fills-beam assumption and a single Tex, with large uncertainties (+1.4/-0.9e17)
The IRAS 16293B upper limit is set by eye from one synthetic spectrum at one offset position with assumed source size
Comparison of ratios across sources mixes different beams, positions and literature analyses
Formation-route discussion is speculative with no modelling or quantitative test
